jobs.title: Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a DCM Assistant Manager to lead credit analysis and support the structuring of debt instruments, such as sukuk and bonds, for our corporate clients. The role combines rigorous credit assessment with transaction structuring and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive credit analysis and investment evaluation for corporate clients and debt capital market transactions.
Support the financial structuring of debt instruments, including sukuk, bonds and other financing solutions.
Assess financial statements, cash flows, leverage, liquidity and overall creditworthiness.
Identify and evaluate credit risks, and propose mitigating factors and structural protections.
Prepare credit and investment evaluation reports with clear recommendations for management and committee decisions.
Review financial and non-financial information to support credit, structuring and investment decisions.
Monitor existing exposures, issuer financial performance and covenant compliance.
Conduct industry and market analysis relevant to credit assessment and transaction structuring.

Requirements

3–5 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial structuring or investment evaluation.
Strong experience in corporate credit analysis.
Completion of a credit course is mandatory.
Solid understanding of financial statements, credit risk assessment and debt structuring.
Excellent financial analysis, modeling and analytical skills.
Advanced Excel skills and strong attention to detail.
Experience in banking, debt capital markets, financial services, fintech or investment is preferred.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to lead financial and investment evaluations, build and review financial models, and coach a team of analysts. The role turns financial insight into clear recommendations for senior management.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the review of business models and cash flow channels, identifying key strengths, weaknesses and risks.
Review and challenge financial statements, financial models and business performance, and give clear recommendations to management.
Build and review complex financial models, forecasts and valuation analyses, and check the quality and accuracy of the team's outputs.
Lead financial and investment evaluations to support strategic and business decisions.
Track financial performance and flag key trends, variances and areas for improvement.
Oversee budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.
Supervise, coach and develop a team of financial analysts, and review their work.
Prepare and present reports and presentations to senior management and key stakeholders.

Requirements

3–5 years of experience in financial analysis.
Completion of a credit course is mandatory.
Advanced financial modeling, valuation and analytical skills.
Strong understanding of financial statements, business models and financial performance indicators.
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
Strong leadership, communication and presentation skills.
Close attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
Banking experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Fixed Income Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Fixed Income Portfolio Manager to lead the fixed income portfolio within our Investment Team. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in managing fixed income portfolios, liquidity and treasury strategy, and investment execution, and can turn market insight into sound investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Own and manage the fixed income portfolio, setting allocation and duration strategy in line with the company's objectives, risk appetite and regulatory limits.
Develop and present investment recommendations to senior management and the Investment Committee.
Oversee daily cash flow and liquidity management so the company always meets its operational and investment needs.
Lead the execution of fixed income transactions, securing competitive pricing and efficient execution across the market.
Own short- and long-term cash flow and liquidity forecasting, and use it to guide investment and funding decisions.
Analyze financial markets, interest rate trends and economic indicators to anticipate market movements and position the portfolio accordingly.
Monitor portfolio performance against benchmarks, manage investment risks and identify new investment opportunities.
Build and lead strong relationships with banks, brokers and other financial institutions, and negotiate favorable terms.
Supervise, coach and develop the fixed income team, reviewing their analysis and execution.
Prepare regular portfolio, performance and risk reports for management.

Requirements

7–10 years of experience in fixed income investments, treasury or portfolio management, including at least 2–3 years managing a portfolio or leading a team.
In-depth knowledge of fixed income instruments, such as treasury bills, bonds and sukuk, as well as interest rate and duration management.
Proven experience in liquidity management, cash flow forecasting and treasury strategy.
Strong financial market analysis, risk assessment and decision-making skills.
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior management or investment committees.
Leadership skills and the ability to work under pressure with close attention to detail.
Experience in banking, asset management or an investment firm is required.
A CFA or a relevant professional certification is a plus.
